description: Detector rules for protected human decision points. If the current state matches any protected class, the action may not proceed past SCAFFOLD/ASK without explicit user authority. Grounded in the plan v2 Layer 3 preserve list.

protected_classes.description: A commitment the user would be bound by
What an experience means to the user
How the user stands toward another person
A decision whose branches change future option space

detection: agent about to conclude about the user

protected_classes.description: Whether an inferred motivation is accepted
detection: lattice insight about to influence action

detection_policy.uncertain: if unclear whether a class matches, treat as matched (conservative)
detection_policy.override: user can explicitly waive a class for a specific action (recorded)
detection_policy.evidence: detection flags are heuristics, not verdicts; user authority always prevails
